cards.card_text: The LORD had turned the heart of the king of Assyria toward them, to strengthen their hands in the work on the house of the God of Israel.
cards.verse_text: For seven days they kept the Feast of Unleavened Bread with joy, because the LORD had made them joyful and turned the heart of the king of Assyria toward them to strengthen their hands in the work on the house of the God of Israel.
